title: A supplier has stopped responding
summary: A calm sequence for re-establishing contact, protecting the schedule and escalating only when silence becomes operationally material.
contentNotice: Demonstration playbook for interface validation. It is not final MOSCATELLI policy and must be reviewed before operational use.
scenario: Use this when a supplier has missed an expected reply or agreed update and the silence could begin to affect a sample, quotation, production milestone or decision.
immediateAction: Verify the last agreed response date and the most recent complete message thread.
Send one concise follow-up that states the pending question, the original expectation and the next decision date.
Record the follow-up in the relevant project record and set a specific next-check time rather than repeatedly chasing.

whoToInform.when: When the missed reply affects a committed internal milestone.
When production, cash commitment or launch timing may be affected.

whatToRecord: Decision or milestone that may be affected
escalationConditions: A second agreed response point passes without acknowledgement.
The supplier becomes unreachable across the established business channels.
The delay threatens a payment, production slot, launch date or material commitment.

templatesResources.label: Concise supplier follow-up
templatesResources.text: Reference the pending item, restate the agreed timing, ask for a clear update, and state the date by which MOSCATELLI needs a response.

templatesResources.label: Project decision record
templatesResources.text: Capture the impact and next decision point in the relevant MainHub record once integration is active.
